schema_note: Expected results encode CORRECT SDC/Tcl behavior (not current tool output). Golden cases are deterministic and high-confidence only.

references.tcl_comments: Tcl(n) man page Rule [10]: '#' starts a comment only at the beginning of a command (start of line or after ';'). https://www.tcl-lang.org/man/tcl8.6/TclCmd/Tcl.htm
references.tcl_continuation: Tcl(n) Rule [9]: backslash-newline is replaced by a single space in a prepass, joining physical lines into one logical command.
references.tcl_numbers: Tcl expr(n) 'Floating-point value': 2.1, 3., 6e4, 7.91e+16 valid; leading-dot '.25' is NOT a valid Tcl literal.
references.sdc_uncertainty: set_clock_uncertainty [-setup|-hold|-rise|-fall] value objects — flags optional; value may directly follow command.
references.sdc_clock_groups: set_clock_groups -asynchronous|-logically_exclusive|-physically_exclusive -group clock_list [-group clock_list ...]; braced Tcl lists valid.
references.sdc_input_delay: set_input_delay [-max|-min] value ... — negative -min values are legal.
references.sdc_generated: create_generated_clock -source [get_ports|get_pins ...] — source may be a pin.

cases.purpose: A full-line comment mentioning create_clock must not create a phantom clock.
Trailing '#' text on a command line must not corrupt parsing.
Backslash-newline joins create_clock lines into one command (name/period/port on continuation lines).
-max/-min/-clock on continuation lines must still be detected (no false SDC-028).
'10' and '10.0' both parse as 10.0.
Scientific notation parses exactly: 2.5e-1 == 0.25; 3.0e-1 >= 0.25 → SDC-008.
Negative -min delay is legal and must not produce errors.
Tcl variables: $CLK_PERIOD=2.5, $IN_DLY=6.0 → 6.0 >= 2.5 → SDC-008 after resolution.
Two primary clocks on different ports → 1 pair, asynchronous.
Same-port primary clocks, different periods → physically exclusive.

Generated chain via -master_clock: clk→div2→div4. Checker: 1 primary + 2 generated. Converter must report 3 clocks with periods derived from the master (-divide_by 2 DOUBLES the period: div2=10.0, div4=20.0). Clock relations: 3 pairs, all synchronous, 0 missing.
Generated chain via -source pins only (no -master_clock): still a synchronous chain of 3 clocks; converter must derive periods from the source chain (div2=10.0, div4=20.0).
Async pair correctly declared → 0 mismatches, 0 missing.
Same-port clocks declared -asynchronous → SDC-060 mismatch expected.
Braced list '{clk_a clk_b}' = 2 clocks in one group; only clk_a/clk_b (same group) is genuinely undeclared → missing must be 1, not 3.
I/O delays equal/exceeding the clock period → SDC-008 and SDC-009.
Multicycle -setup 2 with matching -hold 1 → no SDC-021.
Pure garbage (no command-like tokens) → SDC-001, no crash.
REG: comments containing commands must not produce phantom SDC-002/SDC-008 (currently fails).
REG: continuation-line flags must be seen → 0 errors (currently fails with SDC-028/029).
REG: flag-first uncertainty 100.0ns must trigger SDC-023 (currently missed).
REG: clock on 'data_in' must trigger SDC-007 (currently missed).
